sources.excerpt: Edition (color): Black White Light [Dealer Exclusive] Blue White Sold Out In celebration of Spaceman’s 15th anniversary, we revisit the very first Spaceman pedal with the Rumblefuzz II . We added several upgrades to the original 2009 Rumblefuzz circuit, including: 10db’s of additional output volume; an additional third toggle switch position; and increased tonal range on the Rumble control. From transparent amp-like overdrive to thick sustain-laden wall of fuzz, the Rumblefuzz II offers a wide palette of harmonic distortion. This pedal acts as an extension of your instrument, with a natural dynamic interaction to your playing and instrument controls. True to its name, the Rumblefuzz II shines on bass and baritone guitars, featuring full round lows and a unique bite that perfectly cuts through the mix. The focused panel layout is simple to use, while offering significant tonal adjustment due to the interactive nature of its controls. The RUMBLE control tailors the bass response of the circuit, from tight overdrive tones to incredibly fat fuzz. BITE controls the gain of the circuit and allows for a similar range – with overdrive, distortion and fuzz levels of gain on tap. The */= toggle switch adds three voicing options to the pedal, with its cryptic symbols carried over from the original Rumblefuzz. The idea here was to experiment and listen without preconceived notions. Each position affects bias, compression and presence in different ways. FUZZ controls output volume and is capable of overdriving your amp even on low BITE settings. “I returned to Spaceman earlier this year after leaving in 2019 to pursue other sonic endeavors. As a new beginning with a nod to the past, I wanted to upgrade the Rumblefuzz to be more versatile while retaining everything that was loved about the original.” -Zak Martin, Spaceman founder A new limited batch is now available for pre-order, which includes the Black Edition and White Light Edition ( store exclusive ). The 2024 first editions included two signed and numbered colors of the Rumblefuzz II: 60 in White and 100 in Blue. All handmade PDX Custom pedals are significantly limited by their nature, but specific colors may not always be strictly limited. **The Rumblefuzz II will only exist as a handmade pedal, made in small batches. RUMBLEFUZZ II FEATURES Rumble control manages bass response Bite control provides a wide gain-range offering overdrive, distortion and fuzz Toggle switch provides three voicing options, affecting presence, bias and compression Powered by hand-selected BC108 transistors Unique, discrete all-analog circuit using through-hole components Completely soldered and wired by hand in Portland, Oregon True-Bypass switching Heavy duty engraved vinyl faceplate Large “jewel” indicator light Two signed and numbered Second Editions: Black and White Light Two signed and numbered First Editions: White (60), and Blue (100) TRULY HANDCRAFTED Fully soldered and wired by hand in Portland, Oregon, the Rumblefuzz II features true-bypass switching via soft-click footswitch. On top of the cast-aluminum enclosure sits a durable, engraved vinyl faceplate and jewel indicator light. This pedal is built to last a lifetime, both on Earth or in the vacuum of space and carries a Limited Lifetime Warranty to prove it.
